purpose: Enforce equivalence between shared current bindings and owner-specific open current-history rows, including one-way history lifecycle rules across Schedule, Actual, Session, recurrence and Temporal Constraint.

state_history.current_binding: The sole open owner-specific history episode must exactly match the corresponding shared current binding; Temporal Constraint uses scoped_current_material_state with facet temporal_constraint.rule.
state_history.chronology: Insert-open / close-once / no-reopen lifecycle is enforced. B04-A _32 hardens table-first dispatch so each owner-specific history family dereferences only its own identity column.
state_history.immutability_policy: History identity/state/from fields are immutable; only valid one-way closure is accepted.

lifecycle.delete_behavior: Runtime history deletion is not a baseline capability.

obligations: M5 current/history equivalence, one-way lifecycle and routine-security proof
B04-A Temporal Constraint revise/retire current-history equivalence
B04-A _32 dispatch regression across Schedule, Actual, Session, Routine recurrence, Event recurrence and Temporal Constraint
